title: Asynchronous provider assessment
normative_text: Request handlers must enqueue provider assessment asynchronously and return without waiting for remote provider responses. Provider calls must execute in a queue worker, not inline on the request path.
rationale: Protect request latency and capacity from slow external providers.

violation_patterns: directly calls the remote provider during request
remote provider before the request returns
deviation_check.note: Phrase-based demo control only; production assessment must verify the evidence chain and control semantics.

title: Secrets must not enter logs
normative_text: Authentication secrets, bearer tokens, API keys, and sensitive payloads must not be emitted into application logs. Log structured identifiers and redact sensitive fields.

deviation_check.note: Phrase-based demo control only; inspect exact log call and sensitive-value provenance.

title: Idempotent event processing
normative_text: Event consumers must tolerate at-least-once delivery. External effects need a stable idempotency key, and database state plus outbound events must use an outbox or reconciliation strategy.
rationale: Avoid duplicate effects and lost events across retries.

violation_patterns: duplicate processing may repeat a downstream side effect
deviation_check.note: Retries alone are not a violation; evidence of unsafe repeated effects is required.

title: Aurora PostgreSQL vector retrieval
normative_text: ADR chunks and applicability metadata are stored in Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector. Retrieval combines vector similarity with hard filters for status, repository, service, and validity; every result preserves ADR version and source provenance.
rationale: Keep semantic search auditable and prevent retired or out-of-scope decisions from entering assessment context.

compliance_patterns: preserves adr version and source provenance
deviation_check.note: Demo-level signal only; inspect SQL query and ingestion metadata to confirm.

title: Transactional outbox for workflow dispatch
normative_text: Do not assume an atomic transaction spans a relational write and workflow/event dispatch. Persist an outbox record with domain state and dispatch idempotently with reconciliation.

violation_patterns: database write then event dispatch without outbox
direct workflow dispatch after database commit
deviation_check.note: The existence and transactional boundary of the outbox must be verified in code.

title: Retired synchronous provider integration
normative_text: Legacy provider calls may be made synchronously from legacy-gateway request handlers.
rationale: Historical exception for the retired integration.

title: Administrative frontend accessibility
normative_text: Administrative UI changes must preserve keyboard navigation and accessible names for interactive controls.

violation_patterns: interactive control has no accessible name
deviation_check.note: Static phrase checks are only signals; run accessibility/browser checks for material changes.

title: Worker concurrency and bounded provider calls
normative_text: Workers must bound concurrent provider calls, configure timeouts, and apply bounded retries with jitter and provider-aware rate limiting.
rationale: Prevent provider overload and unbounded resource consumption.

deviation_check.note: Control requires confirmation of effective configuration and error paths.
